title: 还原原数组
summary: 给定由每个原数分别减去和加上同一正整数 k 后混合得到的数组，还原任意合法原数组。
insight: 排序后最小数必是某个原数的低值。枚举它与另一数的正偶数差作为 2k；用频次表从小到大把每个尚未配对低值与 low+2k 配对。
pitfalls: 重复数需要按频次配对
候选失败后要重建频次

solutions.title: 枚举差值与多重集配对
solutions.idea: 确定 2k 候选后贪心配对当前最小剩余值。
steps: 枚举 nums[i]-nums[0] 为正偶数的 gap
复制频次；顺序扫描，若 low 仍有剩余则同时消耗 low 与 low+gap，记录 low+gap/2；恰得 n 个即返回

code.java: class Solution { public int[] recoverArray(int[] nums){Arrays.sort(nums);int half=nums.length/2;for(int candidate=1;candidate<nums.length;candidate++){int gap=nums[candidate]-nums[0];if(gap<=0||(gap&1)==1)continue;TreeMap<Integer,Integer> count=new TreeMap<>();for(int value:nums)count.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);int[] answer=new int[half];int size=0;boolean valid=true;for(int low:nums){int remaining=count.getOrDefault(low,0);if(remaining==0)continue;int high=low+gap;if(count.getOrDefault(high,0)==0){valid=false;break;}decrease(count,low);decrease(count,high);answer[size++]=low+gap/2;}if(valid&&size==half)return answer;}return new int[0];}private void decrease(Map<Integer,Integer> count,int value){int next=count.get(value)-1;if(next==0)count.remove(value);else count.put(value,next);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun decrease(count:MutableMap<Int,Int>,value:Int){val next=count[value]!!-1;if(next==0)count.remove(value)else count[value]=next};fun recoverArray(nums:IntArray):IntArray{nums.sort();val half=nums.size/2;for(candidate in 1 until nums.size){val gap=nums[candidate]-nums[0];if(gap<=0||gap%2==1)continue;val count=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();for(value in nums)count[value]=(count[value]?:0)+1;val answer=IntArray(half);var size=0;var valid=true;for(low in nums){if((count[low]?:0)==0)continue;val high=low+gap;if((count[high]?:0)==0){valid=false;break};decrease(count,low);decrease(count,high);answer[size++]=low+gap/2};if(valid&&size==half)return answer};return intArrayOf()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> recoverArray(vector<int>& nums){sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());int half=nums.size()/2;for(int candidate=1;candidate<(int)nums.size();++candidate){int gap=nums[candidate]-nums[0];if(gap<=0||gap%2)continue;map<int,int> count;for(int value:nums)++count[value];vector<int> answer;bool valid=true;for(int low:nums){if(!count[low])continue;int high=low+gap;if(!count[high]){valid=false;break;}--count[low];--count[high];answer.push_back(low+gap/2);}if(valid&&(int)answer.size()==half)return answer;}return {};} };
